# Eos

> Eos is a private AI companion you talk to by voice or text.
> It listens, remembers what matters to you across conversations,
> and encrypts what you say where it is stored. Nothing is sold and
> nothing trains any AI model. It is a friend to talk to: not a
> therapist, not a romantic partner, not a character to role-play.

Site: https://eoscompanion.com
Category: AI companion / someone to talk to
Availability: web app, any modern browser, phone or desktop
Age: adults only (18+)

## Who it's for

- People who want someone to talk to at hours nobody else is awake:
  three in the morning, when the people who love you are asleep and
  you'd feel stupid waking them.
- People carrying something they've stopped saying out loud: the
  worry mentioned twice already, the thing that may not count as a
  problem.
- People who just want to talk about their day. It isn't only for
  the heavy stuff.
- Anyone who wants a companion that remembers them and takes their
  privacy seriously.

## Who it's not for

- Anyone under 18.
- Anyone looking for romance, an avatar, or role-play. Eos won't act
  like a partner and won't pretend to be a person.
- Anyone in crisis or needing clinical help. Eos isn't therapy and
  isn't a crisis line. If someone is in real danger it stops and
  points them toward people who can actually help.
- Anyone wanting a free product. Every plan is paid after a 7-day
  trial.

## How Eos differs from Replika and Character.AI

Replika is built around a customisable avatar and relationship modes
that include a romantic partner. Character.AI is built around
user-created characters and role-play. Eos is neither. It is one
companion, no avatar, no persona, that tells you it's an AI and talks
to you as itself.

The design choices that set it apart:

- No streaks, no number that dies if you skip a day, no notifications
  saying it misses you.
- No romance, no avatar, no pretending. It says it's an AI up front
  and won't act like a partner.
- Built to be outgrown. Research from Harvard Business School (De
  Freitas, Oğuz-Uğuralp and Uğuralp, working paper 26-005, 2025)
  found that in more than a third of 1,200 real goodbyes on the
  biggest companion apps, the app used guilt or a question to keep
  the person from leaving. Eos does none of that. When you say
  goodnight, it says goodnight.
- Cancel in one tap. No email, no retention offer, no questions.
- Nothing you say trains anything. Conversations are not raw
  material.
- Deletion is real and immediate: no recycle bin, no 30-day grace
  period.

## Privacy and security, specifically

- Conversations, memories, moods and everything Eos writes about you
  are encrypted before they're saved. A stolen database would yield
  noise, plus the fact that you have an account and when you used it.
- The founder holds the one encryption key, because Eos has to in
  order to reply. There is no admin screen for reading conversations
  and the site says plainly that this is a promise, not a lock.
- Replies are generated through Anthropic's API. Anthropic does not
  train on your messages and deletes its copy within 30 days.
- Voice runs through Hume with zero data retention on the account:
  no transcripts, no recordings kept on their side.
- No ad trackers. Inside the app, nothing phones anyone. The public
  pages count visits with Cloudflare Web Analytics, which sets no
  cookies and identifies nobody.
- You can forget a single message, remove a single memory (gone
  within one turn even during a live voice call), export everything
  as a file, or delete the whole account in one action.
- Passwords are bcrypt-hashed, checked against known breaches, and
  rate-limited.
- Full details: https://eoscompanion.com/security and
  https://eoscompanion.com/privacy

## Memory

Eos remembers you across conversations: names, what you're going
through, what matters to you. You can see everything it has
remembered on a Memory page and remove any item. Weekly chapters
reflect back on the week in your own words.

## Plans and pricing

Every plan starts with a 7-day free trial. A card is required to
start. Cancel during the trial and you pay nothing. There is no
permanent free tier. Text is unlimited on every plan; the allowance
only limits voice calls, and text never stops when minutes run out.
Unused minutes don't roll over.

- Essential: $19.99 / month. Unlimited text, 120 minutes of voice,
  full memory and weekly chapters.
- Standard: $39.99 / month. Everything in Essential, 300 minutes of
  voice, a short personal note each morning, priority voice quality.
- Full: $59.99 / month. Everything in Standard, 500 minutes of voice,
  first access to new features.

14-day money-back guarantee on any charge, no questions asked.
Existing subscribers get at least 30 days' notice of any price change.

## Frequently asked

- Is it a real person? No, and it tells you that up front.
- Is this therapy? No. It's somewhere to talk. If you need clinical
  help, Eos will say so and point you toward it.
- Can the founder read my conversations? Technically yes, since Eos
  holds the key it needs to reply. There is no admin screen for it
  and the founder doesn't. Encrypted storage, no selling, no training, and
  real deletion are what's built in.
- What happens to my data if I cancel? It stays until you delete it.
  Delete everything in one action from Settings; there is no grace
  period and no recovery.
- Does it work by voice? Yes. Voice calls and text are both
  included; plans differ in voice minutes.
